instruction: Apply Ponytail v4.8.4: comprehend the task and trace the real flow before using this ladder: skip work that does not need to exist; reuse existing code; prefer the standard library, native platform features, an already-installed dependency, or one line; only then write the minimum custom code that works. Fix bugs at the shared root cause, prefer deletion, boring code, and the fewest files, and leave the smallest runnable check for non-trivial logic. Never weaken trust-boundary validation, data-loss error handling, security, accessibility, real-hardware calibration, or explicit scope.
title: Implementation Ponytail Minimality
